description: List the ATCSCC advisories issued on one UTC date, newest first, from the FAA advisories database's per-date index: ground stops and delay programs as issued, proposed, revised, and canceled, required reroutes, flow constrained areas, operations plans, and CDM compression advisories, including those no longer active and those on past dates, which the NAS Status feed does not carry. Each row gives the advisory number, control element, subject, any further title lines (a reroute's name, constrained area, and valid period), and send time; its number and date open the full text with faa_delays_get_advisory. Narrow by categories or by control_element (an airport, its ICAO code, an ARTCC, or DCC for national advisories), and page with limit and offset.

categories.description: Only advisories the FAA files under these categories: ground_stop, ground_delay_program, airspace_flow_program, ctop, route, other (flow constrained areas and operations plans file under other). Also accepts gs, gdp, afp, spelled-out names such as "ground stop", and a comma-separated string; case-insensitive. Omit for every advisory, including CDM compression advisories, which the FAA files under no category.

control_element.description: Only advisories whose control element is this facility or lists it as a part: an airport by FAA identifier (ORD) or ICAO code (KORD), an ARTCC (ZAU), a pair (ORD/ZAU or KORD/ZAU), or DCC for national advisories such as reroutes and the operations plan. Case-insensitive. Airports named only in a subject or details do not match.

date.description: UTC date to list, YYYY-MM-DD; MM/DD/YYYY and M/D/YYYY are also accepted. Omit for today (UTC). No later than tomorrow (UTC); past dates remain available.

offset.description: Matching advisories to skip, for paging: nextOffset from the previous page.

name: faa_delays_list_advisories

advisories.description: Advisories issued on date that match categories and control_element, newest first: up to limit of them, starting at offset.

controlElement.description: Airport/ARTCC pair or facility the advisory concerns, as the FAA lists it (BOS/ZBW, DCC for national advisories); absent when the index lists none.

date.description: Advisory UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD; pass it as date to faa_delays_get_advisory.

details.description: Further brief-title lines (FAA-authored): a reroute's or flow constrained area's name, constrained area, and valid period.

number.description: ATCSCC advisory number; pass it as advisory_number to faa_delays_get_advisory for the full text.

sentAt.description: When the advisory was sent, ISO 8601 UTC.

subject.description: First line of the brief title (FAA-authored) without its ATCSCC ADVZY prefix, e.g. CDM PROPOSED GROUND DELAY PROGRAM or ROUTE RQD /FL.

appliedCategories.description: The categories filter as the server normalized it; absent when omitted, which reads every advisory, uncategorized ones included.

appliedControlElement.description: The control_element filter as the server matched it: uppercased, each ICAO airport code in it mapped to its FAA identifier (KORD → ORD, KORD/ZAU → ORD/ZAU); absent when omitted.

cap.description: The limit applied; present only when more advisories remain.

date.description: The UTC date read, YYYY-MM-DD; today (UTC) when date was omitted.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `advisory_service_unavailable`: FAA advisories database unreachable, 5xx, an attempt timeout, or a page that is not an advisory index (an error page), after retries. `upstream_rate_limited`: The advisories host returned 429 after retries, or this server's queue to it would wait past 10 s while backing off from that host's 429. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The 20 s retry budget ran out. `pacer_shed`: This server's queue to the advisories host would wait past 10 s with no 429 backoff in effect. `advisory_contract_changed`: Advisory index found (caption present) but no row is readable, or the path returned 404/410. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: offset of the next page; present while matching advisories remain past this one.

notice.description: Guidance on an empty date, a filter that matched nothing, an offset past the end, more pages, and index rows that could not be read.

shown.description: Advisories on this page; present only when more remain.

totalCount.description: Advisories on date that match categories and control_element, before paging.

truncated.description: True when matching advisories remain past this page; absent otherwise.

title: List ATCSCC Advisories
